Subject: FintechCorp — Post-call: IR/BCP evidence & SOC 2 status

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Good to meet you and Maya. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Summary: You confirmed FintechCorp is evaluating Redwood for payment compliance workloads with a hard requirement for SOC 2 Type II evidence, breach notification SLAs, and documented BCP/DR artifacts.
- Immediate asks you flagged:
  1) SOC 2 status and a redacted report or bridge letter
  2) Confirmation of our incident response timelines and breach notification process (for contractual SLOs)
  3) Sample BCP/DR evidence (RTO/RPO statements, runbooks)
  4) Vendor security questionnaire initiation (you'll share the questionnaire)

Next steps I propose:
1) I can share a redacted SOC 2 report + short IR runbook extract by EOD Monday (Jun 29).
2) Marissa (security) will follow up with a short write-up of our breach notification timeline and escalation flow.
3) Ben (sales engineer) will spin up a quick architecture note showing how data is isolated for payment tokens so you can share with your security team.
4) Schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security/compliance team next week — what days work for you?

If you prefer, send over the vendor questionnaire and we’ll kick off the intake.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: FintechCorp — Post-call: IR/BCP evidence & SOC 2 status

Jordan —

Appreciate the recap. That aligns with our notes. A few clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: We need either a current Type II report or an SOC 2 bridge letter plus date of next audit. If you can provide a redacted report that works for initial review.
- Breach notification: Our legal team requires a contractual timeline (e.g., notify within 72 hours of detection + regular updates). Need to see your incident detection/acknowledgement timelines and whether you support customer-driven notification templates.
- BCP/DR evidence: high level RTO/RPO ranges and any tabletop/exercise summaries are helpful. We typically won't accept full internal docs, a redacted summary is fine.

I'll attach the vendor security questionnaire in a separate email (procurement will send). Please route responses to me and Maya — we'll coordinate with procurement for procurement artifacts.

We have availability next Tue/Wed morning PST for the security follow-up.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Security & Compliance | FintechCorp
alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com

Jordan / Ben —

Per Jordan's note, attaching the items we agreed to share. I've redacted PII where appropriate. Highlights below.

Attachments included:
- SOC2_report_redacted.pdf — redacted SOC 2 Type II report (covers key Trust Services Criteria; redactions on customer-specific data).
- IR_runbook_extract.txt — 2-page extract that shows detection -> triage -> customer notification flow and responsible teams.
- BCP_DR_evidence_summary.pdf — 1-page summary with RTO/RPO buckets and recent tabletop dates.

Key points to call out for the questionnaire:
- Breach notification: our security org will acknowledge incidents within 24 hours of detection, and we commit to providing an initial customer notification within 72 hours for confirmed compromise affecting customer data. Further cadence is documented in the IR runbook extract; legal templates can be provided on request.
- For emergencies we have an on-call rotation and executive escalation path (PM, Security Lead, Head of Ops) — summarized in the runbook.
- Regarding GDPR/HIPAA: Redwood supports customer-configured data residency and offers covered controls — for HIPAA we execute BAA with customers who require it; we maintain logging/audit trails to support investigations.

Ben — please draft the architecture note for token isolation and I'll review. Jordan — I'll take point on answering the vendor questionnaire; can you add Alex as point of contact and share the file?

-Marissa
